messages:
zara: Postmortem follow-up: we need owners and timelines for KV-eviction remediation and tests (regressions, prompt vectors, load profiles, chaos drill).

evan: I can own the regression automation and CI wiring. ETA: PR with harness + smoke cases by 2025-04-22.

priya: I will curate the promptset: 75 vectors (sanitized sessions + synthetic hot-key bursts). Will include baseline metrics. PR by 2025-04-24.

mike: I'll take load profiles and chaos drill. Plan: steady 200rps 30m, rapid spike 2m 100->800rps, and a 30s replica isolation. Draft k6 + safe-chaos playbook in 48h.

zara: (note: zara misspelled intentionally?) zara: @evan @priya @mike please tag me in PRs. CI gating: fail deploy on p99/p999 breaches or kv-miss delta >9%. Also nightly full reg-suite.

deploy-bot: Created TICKET-6019: "kv-eviction remediation + tests" assigned to evan,priya,mike due 2025-04-30.

evan: For CI cadence I propose quick smoke on PRs, full reg-suite nightly, and weekly 3h soak in staging. Cost-aware.

priya: Promptset will live in tests/promptsets/kv-eviction-2025.json with per-vector expected metrics.

mike: Chaos drill will include explicit abort conditions and a dry-run flag; will post checklist to #runbooks.

zara: Also add recurrence detection: tag future incidents matching kv-tail signatures and surface in our incident index. @mike can you add backlog item?

mike: Added backlog item to TICKET-6020: "incident-signature tagging: kv-tail".

evan: I'll wire regression results into the canary pipeline and set automatic rollback on violations.

zara: Thanks team 44d Keep short updates on TICKET-6019.
